hook.name: ZA_Hook
hook.description: An owner-controlled liquidity management hook that holds tokens and manages Uniswap v4 positions on behalf of authorized operators. Hook callbacks (afterSwap, afterAddLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity) are pure no-ops returning zero deltas; active management is performed via privileged ZA_* functions for minting positions, adding/removing liquidity, and executing swaps through a configured v4 router.
